strategies.overview: Cinccino's blistering Speed and access to Technician, which it can fully take advantage of with Loaded Dice, make it a dangerous setup sweeper that can end games as easily as it can wallbreak for its partners. Passive Pokemon that might try to take advantage of Cinccino like Orthworm and Bronzong aren't safe from it either, as Cinccino can lock them into setting up entry hazards or using Iron Defense with its Encore, giving it free turns to boost with Tidy Up. On top of that, after a turn of setup, its myriad of coverage moves lets it beat anything from Flygon to Swampert easily. However, Cinccino has terrible four-moveslot syndrome, and its STAB move can be easily punished by common Rocky Helmet users like Amoonguss and Galarian Slowbro. Pokemon like Inteleon and Choice Scarf Mienshao can outpace it and threaten it with a KO, but they fail to check it after it boosts. Cinccino's Tidy Up is also a double-edged sword, as it needs the power to achieve many of its KOs, but in using the move, it removes the hazards that were helping limit its switch-ins in the first place, making it somewhat difficult to fit on many teams. Cinccino also struggles to find setup opportunities due its frailty typically only letting it survive one hit.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Protective Pads could be run to not be vulnerable to contact punishment, but with how Cinccino is then forced to use Skill Link, it becomes weaker. On teams that would like an offensive form of entry hazard control, Heavy-Duty Boots + Skill Link can be run on Cinccino alongside U-turn, letting it reliably remove hazards and bring in a wallbreaker for incoming Steel-types. However, the weaker power, along with the fact that there are better hazard removal options generally, causes it to be unused. Tera Blast Fire can be utilized on Cinccino to hit Rocky Helmet Amoonguss and Steel-types like Orthworm and Copperajah, which it can have trouble dealing with otherwise, but Tera Blast being a wasted moveslot before Terastallization means that it's generally worse overall.

Checks and Counters

Steel-types: Orthworm, Registeel, and Copperajah can take all of Cinccino's attacks comfortably and retaliate with a Body Press or powerful Iron Head; on top of that, the latter two can even paralyze and phaze it, respectively. Bronzong can also wall Cinccino and retaliate with Body Press, but it must beware of Knock Off. If any of them set up entry hazards or used Iron Defense as Cinccino came in, they are easily beat one-on-one due to its Encore.

Contact Punishment: Pokemon like Flame Body Chandelure and Static Bellibolt can all cripple Cinccino with a burn or paralysis, and Rocky Helmet users like Overqwil, Amoonguss, and Galarian Slowbro can chip away heavily at Cinccino if it uses Tail Slap, opening it up to being revenge killed even more easily. However, Cinccino can run Rock Blast to take out Chandelure and Knock Off to remove these crippling items.

Revenge Killers: Fast Pokemon, such as Inteleon and Kilowattrel, and Choice Scarf users, like Infernape and Munkidori, outspeed Cinccino and can threaten it with a KO if Cinccino hasn't boosted yet. On top of that, Pokemon with priority like Mach Punch Breloom and First Impression Flygon can revenge kill Cinccino as well. However, for some of these revenge killers, Cinccino can Terastallize into a Ghost-type and use Encore, which then provides it with setup opportunities.

movesets.name: Tidy Up
movesets.description:
Set Details

Knock Off hits Ghost-types that blank Cinccino's STAB attack as well as Bronzong, and Bullet Seed hits certain physically defensive checks like Swampert, Vaporeon, and Milotic. Encore allows Cinccino to take advantage of passive Pokemon like Swampert, Bronzong, and Palossand that use Stealth Rock or heal up, which gifts it more setup opportunities. It also helps Cinccino handle slower setup sweepers like Calm Mind Sylveon and Iron Defense Registeel and Bronzong. Alternatively, Endeavor can be used on Focus Sash sets to heavily dent these same Steel-types for partners like Oricorio-P, Scyther, and Alolan Ninetales, and Triple Axel can be used as a strong coverage move to nail Brambleghast, Gligar, Flygon, and Dragalge. A Cinccino that aims to sweep teams should run Loaded Dice + Technician for maximum damage output. In contrast, if it chooses to be a dedicated lead, Focus Sash + Skill Link allows it to take advantage of both Tidy Up's entry hazard-clearing potential and its multi-hit moves. Tera Ghost allows Cinccino to become immune to Choice Scarf Paldean Tauros-W's as well as Infernape's Close Combat, and it lets Cinccino blank Breloom's Mach Punch and take advantage of it with Encore, giving Cinccino free turns to set up.

Cinccino struggles with breaking through Steel-types like Copperajah, Orthworm, and Registeel, so partners such as Alolan Ninetales, Oricorio-P, Diancie, and Munkidori pair well, as they can help overwhelm these shared checks. Teammates that can benefit from Cinccino's Tidy Up removing hazards like Air Balloon Chandelure, Weakness Policy Incineroar, Choice Scarf Staraptor, and Life Orb Kilowattrel enjoy its presence; on top of that, the former two can handle Steel-types easily with their STAB moves, whereas the latter two can help wear them down. Terrain teams can also take advantage of Cinccino's hazard clearing, as common Terrain sweepers like Oricorio-P, Arcanine, and Grafaiai enjoy not being chipped by hazards. Due to them not being as concerned about Cinccino's Tidy Up removing their hazards, Stealth Rock leads like Eject Pack Flygon and Booster Energy Scream Tail pair best with it. Spikes leads like Froslass and Brambleghast can help wear down checks like Orthworm and Copperajah, and a Sticky Web lead like Galvantula can help Cinccino outspeed Choice Scarf users like Infernape, Hisuian Typhlosion, and Munkidori; however, these teams must be wise about when to send out Cinccino to ensure their hazards aren't completely wasted. Physical walls that carry a way to punish contact moves through their ability like Bellibolt or item users like Rocky Helmet Amoonguss and Galarian Slowbro are issues for Cinccino, so teammates with access to Knock Off such as Incineroar and Heracross can help deal with these walls. Cinccino's frailty often hinders its ability to set up, so partners that can create opportunities like Memento Chandelure or slow pivots like Dragalge and Incineroar are greatly appreciated.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 7 onwards

Price Range: 5-6 points

Overview: Cinccino is a great budget setup sweeper that can deal solid damage with its Technician- and Loaded Dice-boosted multi-hit moves and guarantee entry hazard removal with Tidy Up. Its solid Speed stat and access to Encore mean it can often create setup opportunities for itself, but it can also function in a fast utility role if needed. Cinccino is unfortunately held back by its near-total lack of viable coverage moves that hit Steel-types even neutrally, weakness to contact-punishing effects, and poor defensive stats, which can prevent it from finding setup opportunities and leave it vulnerable to faster revenge killers and strong priority users.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Setup Sweeper: With Technician, Loaded Dice, and several STAB and coverage multi-hit moves, Cinccino can deal a surprising amount of damage despite its middling Attack stat and lack of super effective STAB moves. A great Speed stat and access to Encore mean that Cinccino can create opportunities for itself to safely deal damage or set up with Tidy Up, though it can still struggle to find openings due to its lacking defensive stats.

Wallbreaker: While Cinccino often runs similar sets as a wallbreaker and setup sweeper, its wallbreaker set focuses more on doing damage early-game and sometimes runs Choice Band for more immediate damage. Tidy Up can be used on Loaded Dice sets to allow Cinccino to muscle past its allies' defensive checks and create openings for them to sweep.

Offensive Utility: A great Speed stat along with access to a variety of utility moves means Cinccino can function decently well as a disruptor and entry hazard remover. Moves like Thunder Wave and Encore can stop slower foes from setting up and sweeping, Tidy Up can clear hazards and is notably the one of the few methods of hazard removal that works against Gholdengo, and U-turn allows Cinccino to maintain momentum against incoming foes looking to take advantage of its set's lack of offensive pressure. Knock Off and Super Fang can also be run as damage options with additional utility in item removal and HP halving, respectively.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Tail Slap, Double Edge

Setup Moves: Tidy Up, Trailblaze

Utility Moves: Baton Pass, Encore, Knock Off, Substitute, Super Fang, Thunder Wave, U-turn

Coverage: Bullet Seed, Gunk Shot, Play Rough, Rock Blast, Triple Axel, Ice Spinner

Niche Moves

Facade: Although status-boosted Facade does not reach the damage of Technician- and Loaded Dice-boosted Tail Slap, it can prevent Cinccino from being rendered useless by opposing Flame Body or Will-O-Wisp users.

Focus Blast: Despite Cinccino's poor Special Attack stat, Focus Blast can be used to catch incoming defensive Steel-types off guard and deal more damage to them than its other attacks.

Endeavor: Endeavor can be run with Focus Sash to break through Pokemon that would normally wall Cinccino.

Common Items

Loaded Dice: Loaded Dice allows Cinccino to take advantage of its ability Technician, rather than Skill Link, and should almost always be used when running Cinccino as a setup sweeper. Since Loaded Dice effectively replaces Skill Link, it's worth noting that running any other item on offensive Cinccino sets requires you to also run Skill Link, thereby cutting Cinccino's damage output significantly.

Heavy-Duty Boots: Utility Cinccino sets should use Heavy-Duty Boots to allow Cinccino to switch in to clear entry hazards or prevent sweeps without worrying about taking damage from hazards or losing its important Speed to Sticky Web.

Protective Pads: As many of Cinccino's incoming checks are Rocky Helmet and Rough Skin users, Protective Pads can allow Cinccino to avoid taking heavy recoil damage on its multi-hit attacks.

Niche Items

Choice Band: Choice Band with Skill Link allows Cinccino to deal more immediate damage than Loaded Dice sets and become an even more threatening wallbreaker.

Focus Sash: Focus Sash guarantees Cinccino a chance to use Tidy Up or deal damage against faster foes. It can also be used with Endeavor to quickly break through Pokemon that normally wall Cinccino.

Clear Amulet: Clear Amulet lets Cinccino ignore stat-dropping effects from moves or abilities like Intimidate that could otherwise prevent it from effectively sweeping with Tidy Up.

Tera

Cinccino serves as a solid budget Tera Captain, as Tera can allow it to circumvent its weaknesses. Since all of its viable physical moves aside from Knock Off are resisted by Steel-types , Tera Ground, Fighting, and Fire in conjunction with Tera Blast are all great options that can allow Cinccino to overpower its dedicated checks and continue sweeping. Defensive Tera types such as Tera Ghost, Steel, and Fairy can also make up for Cinccino's lack of bulk and give it free turns to set up.

Draft Strategy

Cinccino can function as a budget option for teams in need of a setup sweeper, entry hazard remover, or both. It should be only be drafted as a setup sweeper if your team has a strong wallbreaker that can break through the defensive Steel-types that wall Cinccino, and it should not be your team's only potential wincon. It can do well as a secondary hazard remover if your primary hazard remover struggles against Ghost-types or Defiant and Competitive users or if your draft features especially hazard-weak Pokemon.

Special Wallbreakers: Physically defensive walls, particularly Steel-types, can prevent Cinccino from sweeping, and thus special wallbreakers such as Iron Moth, Landorus, and Keldeo can remove these threats and provide it an opening. Strong special wallbreakers also force foes to invest more EVs in Special Defense, which further enables Cinccino.

Entry Hazard Removal: When fulfilling the role of a setup sweeper, Cinccino rarely wants to run an item other than Loaded Dice, leaving it exposed to entry hazards on its switch in. Although it can clear hazards itself with Tidy Up, Toxic Spikes and Sticky Web can prevent Cinccino from getting an opportunity to set up. Pokemon such as Corviknight, Great Tusk, and Torkoal can remove entry hazards while also comfortably taking many of the physical Fighting-type attacks that threaten Cinccino.

Entry Hazard Setters: Pokemon with access to Stealth Rock and Spikes such as Mew, Deoxys-D, and Gliscor provide entry hazard support, which weakens foes on their switch in and can help enable a Cinccino sweep. These examples additionally resist Fighting and can switch into super effective attacks that threaten Cinccino.

Slow Pivots: Cinccino's poor defensive stats mean it can struggle to switch in or even survive long enough to set up, so slow pivots with access to debilitating moves like Parting Shot and Will-O-Wisp can allow it to come in safely while also providing a setup opportunity in front of a weakened foe. Pokemon like Incineroar, Moltres, and Pecharunt fulfill this role well. Slow pivots that can set Light Screen and Reflect like Grimmsnarl and Deoxys-D can similarly provide safe setup opportunities for Cinccino.

Checks and Counters

Steel-type Pokemon: Cinccino's only viable physical coverage move that hits Steel-types neutrally is Knock Off, meaning most defensive Steel-type Pokemon can stop a Cinccino sweep in its tracks. Pokemon like Corviknight, Skarmory, and Orthworm wall Cinccino particularly well and can threaten a KO back with Body Press.

Contact Effects: Two of Cinccino's most powerful moves, Tail Slap and Triple Axel, are contact multi-hit moves, meaning Rocky Helmet and Pokemon with abilities like Rough Skin, Static, and Flame Body can easily punish offensive Cinccino sets. Pokemon with these abilities that can comfortably hold Rocky Helmet and have enough bulk to survive a hit from Cinccino such as Garchomp, Zapdos, and Heatran threaten it greatly.

Faster Threats: Although Cinccino has a decent Speed stat, its frailty means that it can easily be OHKOed by offensive threats that outspeed it like Meowscarada and Iron Valiant. Choice Scarf and Booster Energy, respectively, can allow these Pokemon to outspeed Cinccino even after a +1 Speed boost from Tidy Up, and faster Unburden users can outspeed it after a +2 Speed boost. Cinccino's frailty also leaves it vulnerable to priority attacks. Pokemon such as Kingambit and Bisharp threaten STAB Sucker Punch while also resisting Cinccino's STAB moves and many of its coverage moves.

Entry Hazards: Offensive Cinccino sets almost always run Loaded Dice, meaning Cinccino is vulnerable to entry hazards. Spikes and Stealth Rock can put it in KO range of many priority moves, and Sticky Web can make it difficult for Cinccino to set up safely. Spikes and Stealth Rock users like Garchomp and Skarmory can fulfill this role while providing defensive utility against Cinccino, and Sticky Web users like Ribombee and Araquanid can set Sticky Web while providing general offensive utility.
